note: Groub St runs S (slightly SSE) from Ralston between block 70 (lots 98-31) and block 71 (lots 48-31); it does not continue N of Ralston (block 67 SW corner there). Ralston label printed only as 'RALSTO...' at the right edge of 37L; whole crossing visible. Point = Groub centreline meeting Ralston centreline, just W of block 67's SW corner.
Same crossing as t05_37L (37R ~ 37L - 5632 in x, same y). Groub St T's into the S side of Ralston; Groub ~75 px wide, Ralston ~95 px wide and rising slightly to the east.

Geringer St is a continuous SW-NE diagonal: 'GERINGER' printed on the SW segment (between blocks 66 and 70) and 'ST.' on the NE segment (between blocks 65 and 67); the two segments' centrelines line up. Ralston comes in from the E and meets Geringer in a widened open plaza (a small triangular lot '40'/3620 stands in it, NE of the point). An unnamed 60' strip continues W/NW from the same spot between lot 10/114 (block 65) and lot 113 (block 66) to the canal bank, so it could be read as a cross with a slight bend; I took the point where Ralston's centreline, the stub's centreline and Geringer's centreline meet.

Same crossing as t06_37L. Only 'ST.' (NE segment) and the tail of 'GERINGER' are printed on 37R. Geringer centreline x ~ 400 - 0.53*(y-3100); Ralston centreline meets it at ~(210,3458). Unnamed 60' stub to the canal leaves W from the same point.

Geringer St and Groub St do not meet. Both run S from Ralston Avenue and diverge, both ending at the S property line (501.64' N 87 30' E, Fulton farm beyond) at about x 5440 and x 6030, y ~4020. Groub T's into Ralston at ~(6014,3410); Ralston then continues ~170 px W to meet Geringer at ~(5842,3458). Groub does not continue N of Ralston.

Same as t08_37L: no Geringer/Groub crossing. Nearest points: Groub/Ralston T at ~(382,3410) and Geringer/Ralston at ~(210,3458), joined by a ~170 px stretch of Ralston. South ends of both streets stop at the S property line (~y 4010).

Ludlow Ave is the through street, bending here from a NW-SE leg to a SSE leg; Lafayette Ave starts here and runs ENE. A 50' unnamed street also leaves N from the same open crossing (between block 50 and the C.O. Bowdle lot), so the open area is 4-way; I took the middle of the open crossing (hydrant at ~(4915,3810) on its N side). Separately, a dash-dot 'PROPOSED LUDLOW' line (City of Cincinnati) runs SSE W of the existing street; it does not meet Lafayette.

Same junction as t10_37R, at the top-left corner of plate 22-38's mapped area. Lafayette runs ENE (60'), Ludlow runs SSE along the W side; the NW leg of Ludlow and the 50' street stub to the N (hydrant at ~(67,557)) are cut off by the mapped-area boundary close to the crossing, but the crossing itself is inside the plate.
